device.description: 14-bit 50 kHz 1.8 V micropower bipolar-input sampling ADC with 3-wire serial interface
device.note: ads8324.pdf (SBAS172A) p.2 pin configuration and assignments, p.3 specifications (VCC range 1.8-3.6 V, binary two's complement), p.9 digital interface, Table I timing (VCC = 1.8 V), Figure 5 timing, data format (Table II)

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3 (specifications: VCC range 1.8-3.6 V, two's complement), p.9 (serial interface, Table I at VCC = 1.8 V: tdDO 250 ns max, tdis 100 ns max; Figure 5; Table II codes, 14-bit code left-justified in 16 bits)
notModeled: analog input (bipolar differential +In - -In, 0 V reads 0000h); the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (16 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the 4.5-5.0 clock sample period, then the null bit, B13..B0 and two zero dummy bits; further clocks repeat the result LSB first starting with a zero (zeros for the 0 V code) until CS goes high
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
throughput (50 kHz) and DCLOCK frequency limits (0.024-1.8 MHz)
